purpose: Published transport fare and toll examples for source-backed household commuting scenarios, not routed estimates or prices inferred by ZIP.
rule: A ZIP identifies a state example only; it cannot establish a route, crossing, rider eligibility, parking rate, or the actual fare paid. No fees are added without a user's explicit selections.

fares.label: NYC subway / local bus
fares.capNote: $35 rolling seven-day cap when using the same eligible OMNY payment method, for covered full-fare subway/local-bus rides. Eligible free transfers should not be counted twice.
fares.note: Count charged fares, not all boardings. Fare cap is account/device-specific. This simulator assumes one consistent full-fare rider and a weekly pattern.

fares.label: NYC express bus
fares.capNote: $67 seven-day OMNY cap for eligible express-bus journeys using one eligible payment method.
fares.note: Express buses have their own rules and a higher fare cap; mixed express/local journeys require validation against actual charge history.

fares.label: PATH train
fares.passNote: 30-day unlimited pass $131.50, 7-day unlimited $42.75, and 10-trip tickets $31. Different from MTA OMNY and not eligible for OMNY caps.
fares.note: Per-trip TAPP fare. PATH is separate from MTA; connecting to the subway ordinarily means a separate paid fare.

fares.label: NJ Transit rail or bus — route-specific
fares.note: Varies by route, zone, trip, and ticket type. Enter your exact published fare. Monthly products may be cheaper; not computed without route.

fares.label: Chicago CTA L train
fares.passNote: CTA/Pace 30-day pass $75. CTA transfers up to two additional rides within two hours may be free depending on fare rules.
fares.note: Basic CTA train fare; boarding from O'Hare carries a different rate. Eligibility and transfers affect true charge count.

fares.label: Chicago CTA bus
fares.passNote: CTA/Pace 30-day pass $75. Up to two additional qualifying CTA transfers within 2 hours are free.
fares.note: Basic Ventra/contactless bus fare, not cash; cash and some special routes cost differently.

fares.label: Chicago Metra commuter rail — zone-specific
fares.note: Choose a specific origin, destination, and ticket format in the official fare table.

fares.label: Chicago Pace bus — confirm route
fares.note: Different routes and eligible transfers or passes change prices. Enter the actual charged fare.

fares.label: Other bus, subway, train, ferry, rideshare
fares.note: Enter verified fare for the service you actually use.

tolls.label: Port Authority crossing into NY — peak E-ZPass
tolls.note: Class 1, qualifying NY/NJ E-ZPass, correctly read tag; westbound into NJ is not tolled. Peak is weekday 6–10 AM/4–8 PM and weekends 11 AM–9 PM.

tolls.label: Port Authority crossing into NY — off-peak E-ZPass
tolls.note: Class 1, qualifying NY/NJ E-ZPass; off-peak rates only when the qualifying trip occurs off-peak.

tolls.label: Port Authority crossing into NY — Tolls by Mail
tolls.note: Class 1, mail rate, all hours; compare NY/NJ E-ZPass eligibility. Not charged going into New Jersey.

tolls.label: NYC congestion zone — passenger vehicle peak
tolls.note: E-ZPass peak rate, typically once/day, only on eligible entry to the Manhattan Congestion Relief Zone. Crossing credits, exclusions and discounts can reduce the amount.

tolls.label: NYC congestion zone — overnight
tolls.note: Passenger-vehicle E-ZPass overnight rate when eligible; may not apply to your route. Verify exemptions and credits.

tolls.label: Another NY/NJ road toll or rebate-adjusted charge
tolls.note: Enter verified route/bridge/tunnel amount after applicable discounts and credits, rather than stacking incompatible rates.

tolls.label: Illinois Tollway — plaza and account specific
tolls.note: Use the plaza-specific official calculator and your payment method, vehicle class and direction.

tolls.label: Other highway, bridge, tunnel or congestion charge
tolls.note: Only include actual charged trips. Rates vary by vehicle, route, direction, date and toll program.

disclosure: Exact fares can change. The scenario tool does not track location, store ZIPs or calculate live routes. Regional examples are not personal charges.
